statements.quote: We are very confident that we will be in a position to maintain 21% EBITDA for the full year… after giving that [increments], I think we will be in a position to maintain our EBITDA margins at 21% for the whole year.
statements.target: 21% EBITDA margin for full-year FY26, even after absorbing Q3/Q4 salary increments

statements.quote: From next quarter we will start seeing marginal growth on constant currency terms and in Q4 there will be meaningful growth.
statements.target: Q3 FY26: flat to marginal CC growth; Q4 FY26: meaningful growth

statements.quote: The buyer investment will be substantial. In phases, they will reach up to 250 million, not in the first phase, but in phases over the next two to three years.
statements.target: Key automotive customer to invest up to $250M in R&D in phases over next 2–3 years (revenue pipeline for KPIT)

statements.quote: The revenues dropped because we gave a more holistic solution, but our additional revenues due to this will get reflected in the future, because these are mainly AI-based and other solutions.
statements.target: $65M of cannibalised revenue (from shifting to holistic AI-based solutions) expected to materialise in later quarters

statements.quote: We will be in a position to start the project in Q4 and then scale up in the next year.
statements.target: New large-scale project to commence in Q4 FY26 and scale up through FY27

statements.quote: This quarter [Q2]… close to 2.3% benefit from half a quarter sort of consolidation of the Caresoft asset. Next quarter as well, you will get maybe a month, month and a half additional benefit from Caresoft.
statements.target: Caresoft consolidation contribution rises from ~2.3% (half-quarter) in Q2 to a near-full-quarter benefit in Q3 FY26

statements.quote: You did mention that you are expecting more meaningful pickup in FY '27.
statements.target: Management expects a more meaningful revenue pickup in FY27 (partly on resolution of tariff uncertainty)

statements.quote: One-time is about Rs 6 crores. And this time there were no major revenues in the Qorix books, which got postponed to the next quarter to some extent.
statements.target: Qorix associate: ~₹6 cr one-time loss in Q2; deferred Qorix revenues expected to appear in Q3 FY26
